text:
I checked the page-ui proposal and found three wording problems in its owner-facing cards, `page-ui/cards.json`. I sent mastermind-page-design the rewritten text rather than editing the file myself. `node Server/text-check.mjs` found nothing, and no card is over 60 words. I didn't open any page in a browser, since this is a proposal and not a landed task.

- **"The problem" card:** it says "About 50 of Page's only pass a call on", which is missing the word "methods". "Page 97, Item 30, Events 5" is also just numbers. I rewrote it as full sentences.
- **"Good / cost" cards (Idea 1 and Idea 2):** the titles were vague. Each now spells out the good and the cost.
- **"If yes, next" card:** the "$15–25" figure now reads as an estimated cost, and the card gets links to `core/Page/ui/` and the namespaces doc.

I also logged a "sent" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.
